title: Accessible UI primitives and identity keys

claims.text: checkedName normalizes to NFC, collapses whitespace, and enforces a 64-byte UTF-8 budget; attributes writes textContent plus data-lin-action and optional validated entity/id attributes.

createLink rejects scheme, protocol-relative, backslash and control-char hrefs (including decoded form), allows only #/ routes for agents, lineage, arena and ledger, and requires the resolved URL to share the page origin.

renderStatePanel maps each PanelState to a display string, gives error panels a region role, and only accepts the retry-panel action for its retry button; identityKey returns short identities verbatim and hashes longer ones with the synchronous SHA-256.

decision.rule: Change here when accessible names, button or link construction, state panels, measurement formatting, or identity keys need to change.
decision.failure: A control renders with an empty or over-budget name, a link escapes the application routes or origin, or a retry button uses an unregistered action.

questions.q: Where does checkedName enforce the 64-byte accessible name budget?
